config.label: URL of the NATS Trail bridge, e
config.description: URL of the NATS Trail bridge, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4000. Without it the server answers only from local state and cannot reach JetStream.

config.label: Bearer token for the bridge, required when it has auth enabled
config.description: Bearer token for the bridge, required when it has auth enabled. A read-scoped token is enough: this server never mutates.
